profile.headline: Frontend enthusiast, insatiably curious, perpetual learner, tinkerer, mentor    React | Javascript | Node | Web | Mobile | Cloud
profile.summary:
I am a self-motivated, highly dedicated software engineer with a passion for developing quality software solutions using the latest technologies. 

I provide a breadth of experience, spanning all aspects of the software development lifecycle from requirements gathering, to system design, to production delivery and support. My background includes software solutions for a diverse set of application domains such as manufacturing, e-commerce, and healthcare. I've worked across the solution stack: backend, middleware, firmware, and frontend.  I’m experienced with both on-premises and cloud-native software solutions.

My proficiencies include requirements gathering, solution architecture, frontend and backend development, testing, and deployment of enterprise-scale software solutions. I've led multiple globally distributed teams through successful product delivery using various flavors of Agile development.  I am a proven technical leader with excellent oral and written communication skills. I’ve got a passion for learning new technologies as well as mentoring others to become more proficient developers.

Most recently, I've focused my career on frontend development using various JavaScript frameworks and libraries along with middle tier technologies using NodeJS with Express to integrate with backend services using REST or GraphQL.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Software Engineer - Self-sovereign identity and digital credential management
positions.description:
User interface team leadership (web + mobile) for Digital Health Pass team.  Coordinated and managed change requests for all DHP user interfaces transitioning from IBM to Merative.  
  
• Created multiple prototypes to evaluate self-sovereign identity solutions from multiple vendors
• Developed a React Native for Web application for an identity verification service for web and mobile
• Implemented changes to facilitate the contribution of IBM Digital Health Pass into open source
• Leveraged iOS development skills to make modifications to existing mobile applications
positions.insights: Skills: JSON · JavaScript · Hands-on Technical Leadership · iOS Development · HTML5 · Computer Science · Communication · Web Technologies · Single Page Applications · NodeJS · Web Development · Technical Presentations · React · Mentoring · REST APIs · React Hooks · Docker

positions.title: Senior Frontend Software Engineer - IBM Digital Health Pass
positions.description:
Established technical direction and provided leadership and mentoring for multiple web-based user interfaces for IBM Blockchain Solutions for Healthcare for Life Sciences. Principle responsibilities included requirements refinement, estimation, UX design, UI development, solution test and cloud deployment of React + NodeJS front end solutions.

• Technical team lead and lead developer resposible for multiple Digital Health Pass web interfaces
• Managed multiple globally-distributed UI development teams through product deliveries
• Established containerization and cloud deployment strategy for web applications to IBM Cloud
• Created organization-wide technology stack, conventions and best practices for web applications
• Influenced hiring decision by conducting technical interviews for UI developers
• Collaborated with product management, stake holders, user experience and other leads to gather, document, refine, estimate and coordinate project deliverables

positions.title: Advisory Frontend Software Engineer - Watson Health Clinical Trial Matching
positions.description:
Established technical direction and provided leadership and mentoring for IBM Watson for Clinical Trial Matching. Principle responsibilities included mentoring, requirements refinement, estimation, UX design, UI development, and testing of Dojo, Angular and React version of the product.

• Technical lead responsibility over team of 5 UI developers for clinical trial matching solution
• Led multiple UI transitions: Dojo to AngularJS to React, REST to GraphQL, poly-repo to mono-repo
• Developed application deployment, authentication, and security for Watson Health web apps
• Participated in IBM Watson Health Corp residency to improve cancer care in low income countries

positions.title: Advisory Frontend Software Engineer - IBM DataPower
positions.description:
Worked as part of a globally distributed team charged with maintaining and modernizing the IBM DataPower appliance user interface.  Implemented a Javascript user interface on a hardware constrained appliance.  Architected, developed, and tested the deployment policy feature.

• Responsible for the design, development, testing, maintenance and support of web-based user interface for the IBM DataPower appliance.
• Optimized user experience by replacing an outdated, “object-based” user interface with a simplified, task focused user interface. Modernized implementation using Web 2.0 technologies (Dojo/AJAX/REST)
• Responsible for support of existing web interface for all customers on all supported versions
• Drove client satisfaction as a Customer Lab Advocate for IBM DataPower
• Worked across the organization to drive the transformation to an Agile development methodology.

positions.title: Agile Coach
positions.description:
Provided thought leadership, process refinements and coaching to transition a waterfall based development process into an audit-ready QMS agile development process.  Implemented process controls within the change management tooling to enforce compliance and audit-ready status for the project.
  
• Drove adoption of Agile software development methodologies and tooling across organizational boundaries.
• Increased organizational efficiency by replacing existing project management tools with Rational Team Concert (RTC) as a single means to manage and track the Agile delivery of function into multiple products and releases 
• Installed, administered, configured, and customized RTC server.
• Mentored and coached all disciplines on the use of Agile tooling to improve quality and timeliness of software deliveries.

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer - Websphere Process Integration
positions.description:
Contributed to design, test, and development of software products. Defined, recommended, implemented software alternatives and solutions to achieve high level of efficiency and customer satisfaction.

Developer, IBM WebSphere DataPower
• Responsible for the design, development, testing, maintenance and support of web-based user interface for  the IBM DataPower appliance.
• Optimized user experience by replacing an outdated, “object-based” user interface with a simplified, task focused user interface.  Modernized implementation using Web 2.0 technologies (Dojo/AJAX/REST)
• Responsible for support of existing web interface for all customers on all supported versions
• Directly responsible for the success of the product at specific customers as a Lab Advocate for DataPower
• Worked across the organization to drive the transformation to an Agile development methodology.

Developer, WebSphere Process Server
• Developed and supported business object functionality which drives core IBM Business Process Management (BPM) solutions.
• Ported Eclipse Modeling Framework (EMF) based implementation to the industry-standard Service Data Object (SDO) based implementation while maintaining backward compatibility for customers.
• Concurrently developed new feature/function, implemented Unit and Function Test, provided support for customers on all supported versions.

Team Lead, WebSphere Adapter Toolkit
• Architected and led team through implementation of an Eclipse based plug-in which enables simplified creation of Java Connector Architecture (JCA) 1.5 specification compliant Resource Adapters.

Team Lead, WebSphere Business Integration Adapter for Ariba Buyer 
• Led team in the porting of an existing Extract-Transform-Load (ETL) adapter from a deprecated MQ based framework to a WebSphere Interchange Server (WICS) based framework.
• Successful efforts fulfilled strategic market and portfolio needs which led to numerous up-sell opportunities at key customer accounts.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer - Websphere Process Integration
positions.description:
Participated in design, development, test and provided technical input for development of product components with decision responsibility and accountability affecting success of significant portions of the project.

Team Lead, WebSphere Adapter for Ariba Buyer 
• Responsible for the development, testing and support of a Java and MQ Series based, Extract-Transform-Load (ETL) adapter for a 3rd party e-procurement system.  
• Created a strategic IBM solution which broke a competitor's monopoly in this space that opened the door for numerous revenue opportunities for IBM.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Plant floor solutions and B2B e-commerce
positions.description:
As part of development team, worked with architects and senior developers to develop new, modify, improve and support existing software products and solutions.  

Developer, ComponentKnowledge
• Responsible for the analysis, design, and implementation of a credit card billing system for a subscription based E-Commerce site used to communicate and manage New Business Opportunities.
• Provided a Java and DB2 solution which securely submitted charges to a 3rd party credit card processor on a monthly basis based on current user subscriptions.

Developer, MetalView / AutoView
• Participated in the analysis, design, and development of industry-specific, plant floor solutions.  
Developed a customer-facing, object-oriented user interface which allows line operators to mange the galvanization process of steel coils.
• Contributed to the design, test and implementation of bill-of-materials printing system used on the manufacturing floor of a major automaker.

honors.title: Outstanding Technical Achievement Award
honors.description: Received an Outstanding Technical Achievement award for contributions to IBM Digital Health Pass offering.

honors.title: IBM Watson Health Corp
honors.description: Nominated and selected to participate in a 3 week residency targeted around improving oncological care for patients in third-world countries.   As a member of a 5 person multi-national team of technical experts, we were challenged to design a module extension to support chemotherapy ordering and administration in OpenMRS (an open source EMR system used primarily in underdeveloped countries).  Our main objective was to convert paper based chemotherapy records and processes into a digitally managed process.  We designed, implemented and integrated our solution under extreme time constraints and published it as open source to allow further extension and enhancement.  We had the honor of presenting this solution to top executives within IBM.
